北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴天，体感 1℃ 凉意十足，注意保暖别着凉哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy, feels like 1℃. Stay warm and don't catch a cold!
北京.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，湿度较高，体感 13℃ 略显潮湿，注意防潮哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy with high humidity, feels 13℃. Mind the dampness!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海小雨淅沥，体感 11℃。出门别忘带伞，小心路滑！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai has light rain, feels like 11℃. Bring an umbrella, watch for slippery roads!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，体感 27℃ 稍热，注意清爽穿搭，保持舒适！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy, feels 27℃. Dress comfortably and stay cool!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，体感 24℃ 舒适，湿度较大，注意通风哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feels 24℃ and humid. Keep good ventilation!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州中雨，体感 10℃ 湿冷，出行请带雨具，多穿点哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has moderate rain, feels 10℃ and damp. Bring an umbrella, dress warmly!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，湿度 100% 体感 6℃ 湿冷，添衣保暖很重要！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy, 100% humidity, feels 6℃ and damp. Dress warmly!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 19℃ 凉爽，湿度不高，记得补水哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels 19℃ and cool. Low humidity, remember to hydrate!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感 5℃ 伴有风，湿冷感强，多穿衣服！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, feels 5℃ with wind. Very damp and cold, dress warmly!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 8℃ 略凉，出门多添一件衣服，别着凉。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, feels 8℃ and cool. Wear an extra layer, don't catch a cold.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云，体感 20℃ 舒适宜人，正是户外活动的好时候！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels 20℃ and pleasant. A great time for outdoor activities!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗，体感 -14℃ 寒风凛冽，务必穿上最厚的冬装！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is clear, feels -14℃ with bitter winds. Bundle up in your warmest winter gear!
哈尔滨.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴天，体感 -8℃ 寒冷，北风吹拂，注意防风保暖！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy, feels -8℃ and cold. The north wind is blowing, stay warm!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感 16℃ 宜人，微风习习，心情都会变好！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, feels 16℃ and pleasant. A gentle breeze, feel good!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，体感 16℃ 略潮湿，记得室内通风，保持清爽。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels 16℃ and a bit humid. Remember to ventilate indoors!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴天，体感 3℃ 湿冷，注意添衣防寒，别感冒哦。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy, feels 3℃ and damp. Dress warmly to avoid a cold!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴天，体感 0℃ 凉意浓，多穿衣物，小心着凉呀。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels 0℃ and chilly. Dress warmly to avoid catching a cold!
